headlines.title: China seen doing ‘just enough’ with targeted fiscal support to defend GDP growth
headlines.summary:
China’s finance minister has pledged to roll out incremental and targeted fiscal policies to help achieve leadership’s full-year growth target for the country, following a freshly announced package of supportive measures. However, analysts expect Beijing to stop short of a major stimulus, providing only “just enough” support to meet the target.
Lan Foan made the pledge in an article published on Thursday in the Communist Party’s leading theoretical journal, Qiushi, calling for the broadened...
headlines.title_zh: 中国被视为以定向财政支持做到‘恰到好处’以捍卫GDP增长
headlines.summary_zh:
中国财政部长承诺推出增量、有针对性的财政政策，以帮助实现领导层设定的全年增长目标，此前刚宣布了一系列支持性措施。然而，分析师预计北京不会推出大规模刺激，只会提供“恰好足够”的支持来实现目标。

headlines.title: 中资券商加快全球化布局，在中东落子
headlines.summary: 近日，中信建投（国际）金融控股有限公司发布消息称，正式获得迪拜国际金融中心（DIFC）颁发的牌照，并获迪拜金融服务管理局（DFSA）授权，在DIFC设立迪拜代表处。 国泰海通的国际化业务布局也于近日取得新进展：子公司国泰君安国际与哈萨克斯坦阿拉木图市政府正式签署合作备忘录，将在跨境融资等领域建立长期合作关系，助力哈萨克斯坦优质主体对接中国香港国际资本市场，拓宽离岸人民币融资渠道。（券商中国）

headlines.title_en: Chinese brokerages accelerate global expansion with a move into the Middle East
headlines.summary_en: Recently, China Securities (International) Financial Holdings Limited announced that it has officially obtained a license issued by the Dubai International Financial Center (DIFC) and has been authorized by the Dubai Financial Services Authority (DFSA) to establish a Dubai representative office in DIFC. Guotai Haitong's international business layout also made new progress recently: its subsidiary Guotai Junan International signed a memorandum of cooperation with the Almaty city government in Kazakhstan, and the two sides will establish a long-term cooperative relationship in areas such as cross-border financing, helping high-quality Kazakh entities connect with Hong Kong's international capital market and broadening offshore RMB financing channels. (Securities Times)

headlines.title_en: MOFCOM spokesperson answers reporters' questions on the G20 Trade Ministers' Meeting and related matters
headlines.summary_en: Q: From September 30 to October 1, the G20 Trade Ministers' Meeting was held in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, USA. It is understood that the meeting reached a joint statement on opposing the weaponization of food, but did not form an outcome document on addressing overcapacity, eliminating forced labor, or adjusting the most-favored-nation principle. How does China evaluate this meeting? What role did China play? A: At this G20 Trade Ministers' Meeting, members exchanged views on topics set by the U.S. presidency, including opposing the weaponization of food, addressing overcapacity, eliminating forced labor, and adjusting the most-favored-nation principle, and reached a joint statement on the food issue, while no outcome document was formed on the other topics. headlines.title: 有人想离开，也有人排队等着进：空乘下跪事件背后的职业围城 当服务人员处在消费者、平台规则或者企业考核的夹层里时，他们也应当有正常说“不”的权利。
headlines.summary: 近日，中信建投（国际）金融控股有限公司发布消息称，正式获得迪拜国际金融中心（DIFC）颁发的牌照，并获迪拜金融服务管理局（DFSA）授权，在DIFC设立迪拜代表处。 国泰海通的国际化业务布局也于近日取得新进展：子公司国泰君安国际与哈萨克斯坦阿拉木图市政府正式签署合作备忘录，将在跨境融资等领域建立长期合作关系，助力哈萨克斯坦优质主体对接中国香港国际资本市场，拓宽离岸人民币融资渠道。（券商中国）
headlines.title_zh: 有人想离开，也有人排队等着进：空乘下跪事件背后的职业围城 当服务人员处在消费者、平台规则或者企业考核的夹层里时，他们也应当有正常说“不”的权利。
headlines.title_en: Some want to leave, while others are lining up to get in: the career siege behind the flight attendant kneeling incident. When service workers are caught between consumers, platform rules, or corporate assessments, they should also have the right to say no normally.
